steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Growth: When a quantity increases by a fixed percentage each time period (e.g., compound interest, population growth). | Decay: When a quantity decreases by a fixed percentage each time period (e.g., depreciation, radioactive decay).

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: £5000 at 4.5% compound interest for 8 years. Find the final amount. | A laptop costs £1200 and depreciates at 20% per year. Find its value after 3 years. | £3000 grows to £3646.52 at 5% compound interest. How many years?

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Extended Answer 6 marks: A car is bought for £25,000. It depreciates at 15% per year. (a) Find its value after 5 years. (b) After how many years is it worth less than £5000?
